notes.title: Early Access Update-2020.11.14
notes.notes:
-Fix a problem that put unit icons in wrong place
-Fix a problem that cause Mounted Archers do not have shadows
New Campaign Update:
-Player's start money change from 2600 to 3000
-Xiongnu's personnel change from 64000 to 110000
-Mounted Archer's speed in plain increase a little bit
-Xiongnu in Monan and Liangqu will start to move at the same time now
-Dai is also a plunder target of Xiongnu now, the campaign target also change from Gaoliu to Dai
-Change the terrain around Dai, make it easier to defend
-Xiongnu's AI become a little smarter

notes.title: Early Access Update-2020.9.19
notes.notes:
-Add a "discard wounded" function to player's troops
    -The buff icon and troop panel is now bigger
    -Add shadow quality options to "Settings-Graphics"
    -The resolution options now only have 16:9 ones
    -Now the negative campaign records will be cleared
    -All the cells have straight edges now
    -Cells on both sides of rivers is modified in order to make rivers flow on cell's edge, not across it. (Besides, the shape of those cells are more irregular)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37359625/f6800c5d81ad196227e35d3182f86693bd62a577.jpg
    -Cells around lakes is modified to fit the edge of lakes. (Besides, the shape of those cells are also more irregular)
    -Now the “Hindered by river” debuff will only be added when a troop try to get across cells on two sides of river
    -Now the "Show region" option weill no longer display river cells as blue but their orginal color
    -The realms are slightly modified to fit the shape of rivers

notes.title: Early Access Update-2020.8.8
notes.notes:
- tweaks on stealthy force

         - Fighting troops cannot be set as stealthy force now
         - now AI will not try to bypass those stealthy force that they cannot see.
         - stealthy forces now will be compromised when capturing enemy buildings

    - Fixed Chuzi retreating when Zhuxian is captured in the campaign Battle of Jixi
    - Fixed some Qi garrisons getting starved too quick in the campaign Battle of Jixi
    - Added some hints in the campaign Besieging

notes.title: Early Access Update-2020.8.6
notes.notes: - Fixed the issue that in the campaign Wangjian Eliminate Chu, the game cannot be unpaused after Wangjian's arrival.

notes.title: Early Access Update-2020.8.5
notes.notes:
- Fixed a critical bug in the campaign Besieging Wei to Rescue Zhao

         - This bug caused Pangjuan not fighting against player but chosing to stand still

    - Added an achievement of the campaign Besieging and made some minor tweaks about the text in the campaign Food Supply Line
    - Fixed an error report showing that "No key of ..."
    - Fixed an error report showing that "Frontlinebattle ..."

notes.title: Early Access Update-2020.8.4
notes.notes:
- New tutorial Campaign - Besieging

         - teaches about how to use battering rams and how to Besiege

    - Fixed several bugs in the control setting UI
    - Fixed the troop icons not getting correctly updated
    - Now no ZOC will be spawned near allies' forts

notes.title: Early Access Update-2020.8.3
notes.notes:
- Fixed the issue that when the moving speed of a division is zero, its tooltip will disappear. Now the tooltip will correctly suggest its immobility.
    - Fixed an error report showing that "no enemy when finding line"
    - Fixed an error report showing that "garrison ai is no more"
    - Fixed an error report showing that "must be moving to neighbor cell"
    - Fixed a division's personnel count reaching zero but not getting destroyed
    - The death toll of SWG is now not recorded.

    - New feature: grouping

         - Ctrl + number key : create a group
         - Shift + number key : select the group
         - Q : select all troops in the player
         - Tab: camera jump to the selected troops

    - Fixed some bugs that crash the game in the battle of Jixi

notes.title: Early Access Update-2020.8.1
notes.notes:

notes.title: Beta Update-2020.7.23
notes.notes:
Chinese(Traditional) version is now available

New Campaign Level: Battle of Jixi

         - You will play as Yue Yi

    
UI Update

         - Campaign Target UI has been overhauled.
         - Updated the corner button layout.
         - Updated the troop cards display UI.
         - Some other misc UIs have been updated and optimized.


New Feature

         - A BGM player bas been added to the game.
         - Steam achievements are now available.


Bug Fixes

         - Fixed the issue that closing the formation setting UI leads to the loss of the formation pattern when editing an existing formation.
         - Fixed a crash issue when opening the formation setting UI after restarting campaign.
         - Fixed the buff [defending stone wall] not decreasing according to the hit points of the building.
         - Add a missing buff icon for [defending stone wall].
         - Fixed the death tolls of the encircled troops not being recorded.
         - Fixed the issue that sometimes game will crash when AI decides to go back to protect their cities.

notes.title: Beta Update-2020.7.16
notes.notes:
Rebalanced the campaign[Anti Qi Alliance]

 	Enemy garrison will spawn at the newly captured Qi city
 	Start time of this campaign brought foward
 	No harvest event in this campaign in the first year
 	All AI now has lv.3 Intellengence skill
 	Yan army will try to cut down player's supply line

Bug Fixed:

 	An error that prevents the formation with the same name with other custom formation but not exactly the same.
 	Divisions' icons are shifting to the right when they first appears
 	S.W.B marches too fast ignoring the vanguard division
 	Now fortification buff is correctly received in friendly but not self buildings
 	A rare bug that causes divisions destroyed but their icons are left is fixed (maybe)

notes.title: Beta Update-2020.7.15
notes.notes:
English version is now available!

    New Campaign Level: Anti Qi Alliance

         You will play as a Qi general.
         Since our programmers are all busy doing the translation, this level may be not so stable and some improvements are still on the way.


    UI Tweaks

         A small overhaul of troop cards:

             Now only the cards of selected troops will be displayed instead of all the troops in the command center.
            Add morale, equipment, food and personnel information next to the cards

         Fixed the issue that when using high resolution, the campaign title would disappear.
         Some other small tweaks on several UIs.


    Bug Fixes

         Fixed the campaign targets in the level [Besiege Wei to Rescue Zhao] not resetting after restarting the campaign.
         Fixed a description error in battle reports: "The nth Day" is now "The nth Combat"
         Fixed the buff Chariot-infantry combined army being triggered while there is actually no infantries at all.
         Added a new unit trait: Chariot-cavalry combined army.

             If chariot units and cavalry units are mixed in the same division, a buff will be granted.

         Fixed the event window of [Wang Jian is coming] not being able to be closed in the campaign [Qin's Conquest of Chu].
